title: The Last Encore at Palais Garnier
location: Palais Garnier Opera House Dressing Room
motive: Jealousy over lead role in Carmen and extortion regarding fake aristocracy claims.

timeline.event: Overture begins in the main hall.
Madame Dupont enters dressing room for intermission costume change.
Stage manager hears a muffled scream.
Madame Dupont found unconscious holding a broken flower bouquet.

dialogue_placeholders.suspect_002: Genevieve's voice was failing anyway! I had no need to poison her spray!
dialogue_placeholders.suspect_003: I was writing a expose on opera house corruption in the lobby.
dialogue_placeholders.suspect_012: We argued about the script, but I loved her!
